title: Songyue Pagoda
summary: The Songyue Temple Pagoda stands at the southern foot of the Songshan Mountains in Dengfeng, Henan. Chinese sources date it to 520 or 523, in the Northern Dynasties. The brick pagoda is about 39.8 m high, has a twelve-sided plan and fifteen tiers of eaves, and is described as the oldest large pagoda still standing in China.

uncertainty.note: china.org.cn says constructed in 520; China Daily says completed in 523. The span runs from the earlier to the later date.
